BOLLYWOOD BLACKOUT – SAN JOSE 🖤

NACH NACHKE PRESENTS | THE ULTIMATE ALL BLACK AFFAIR

SAN JOSE, WE’RE BACK AT ERA LOUNGE! 🔥

Get ready for another unforgettable night as Nach Nachke takes over Era Lounge with BOLLYWOOD BLACKOUT – an exclusive nightlife experience where the music is loud, the energy is unmatched, and the dress code is strictly BLACK!

We’re bringing together the best of Bollywood, Punjabi, Desi and Hip-Hop music for a night filled with nonstop dancing, incredible vibes, and an atmosphere you won’t want to leave.

Our Era Lounge events have built a reputation for bringing incredible crowds and unforgettable nights. November 14 will be no different. We’re raising the bar once again!

🖤 THE THEME: ALL BLACK EVERYTHING

Dress sharp. Look good. Make a statement.

We’re turning Era Lounge into an all-black affair. Whether you’re going classy, glamorous, or bringing your own signature party style, make sure BLACK is the color of the night.

ALL BLACK ATTIRE IS MANDATORY. NO EXCEPTIONS.

🔥 WHAT TO EXPECT
The best of Bollywood, Punjabi, Desi & Hip-Hop music.High-energy DJ sets and nonstop dancing.An incredible nightclub atmosphere.Premium club lighting and production.An amazing crowd and unforgettable moments.VIP tables and bottle service experiences.

🥂 VIP EXPERIENCE & BOTTLE SERVICE
Coming with your crew? Make a night of it!

Take your experience to the next level with our VIP bottle service options. Enjoy dedicated table seating, a premium nightlife experience, and celebrate with your friends in style.

Bottle service is highly recommended for groups looking for a more exclusive experience and a smoother VIP arrival.

VIP TABLES ARE LIMITED. Advance reservations are strongly recommended.
